TC_MAR.aggregation: per-anchor patch error -> per-carrier mean -> carrier mean/median/p95
TC_MAR.visibility: corrected-v2 visibility at anchor AND valid source/future bounds/finite coordinates
TC_MAR.coordinate_mapping: source 480x832; future evaluator 464x832; x identity, y*=464/480

TC_ME.EPE: L2 norm of RAFT-predicted flow minus corrected-v2 reference displacement/2 at carrier center/2
TC_ME.flow_source: torchvision RAFT Large C_T_SKHT_V2 cached weights; adjacent RGB frames resized area to 240x416; bilinear flow sample
TC_ME.visibility_filtering: visible and finite at both adjacent frames; inbound 240x416 centers
